title: BIVE External Replication Attestation
description: A record submitted by a party who independently reproduced BIVE's frozen anchored result (research/cogveritas/phase0_results.json) from the public corpus, following docs/methodology/EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_GUIDE.md. The integrity gate re-derives whether the reported result reproduces the pre-registered value within its 95% CI; it never trusts a self-declared 'reproduced' flag.

public_repo.description: The attester's OWN public repository/fork that ran the replication.

attester_class.description: 'independent' = a party distinct from the target repository and its automation; only these can lift the benchmark-grade cap. 'self' = the repo's own maintainers/CI — a reproducibility witness, never a third-party attestation.

checksum.description: Optional sha256 of the fetched corpus for exact reproducibility.

protocol_ref.description: The BIVE commit / guide the replicator followed (e.g. 'docs/methodology/EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_GUIDE.md@<sha>').

public_evidence_url.description: A publicly followable artifact (CI run, notebook, log) an auditor can inspect. The gate cannot fetch it; it is the human trust anchor and is required so the claim is checkable, not merely asserted.
